notes.title: Change log (v0.1.30)
notes.content:
We have successfully kept updates weekly so far. Fixes and new features will come frequently.

[previewyoutube=I6Gq4PtOV6I;full][/previewyoutube]
[list]
[*] Controls description is more clear and grouped by input types
[*] Tire screech sound is more sync'd with the actual drifting
[*] VR interaction fixes
[*] Several UI fixes
[*] In-game controller input handling
[*] Hide overpass in VR when going underneath it
[*] Car visual fixes
[*] Selected wheels are persisting on car change

notes.title: Change log (v0.0.145)
notes.content:
Hi there,

Today's update is more about stability, performance, and visual improvements, which are:

[list]
[*] Tire marks, much more tire marks 🙂
[*] Visual tweaking (big performance gain on Quest!)
[*] Finally, the game level doesn't start with the menu
[*] In-game menu navigation is much more comfortable with the keyboard
[*] You can see the next waypoint on the mini-map
[*] Race game mode got a proper start phase with lamps and sound, not just load in and go
[*] Vincent, the v0.1 AI is better now, at least v0.1.1 better 🙂
[/list]

[previewyoutube=gdC0ZsaTeUw;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Easter Special Edition
notes.content:
[b]Jump like a bunny, look like a bunny, and hunt for the easter eggs!
[/b]
1. Complete the "get high" challenge.
2. Go back to the garage and use the bunny ears.
3. Start the race, get all the eggs, but be careful, you might lose one!
4. Extra tip: build your car smart ;-)
